clue.text: One of the 24 that is two and a bit of it: it hurts a bit

parts.words: One of the 24 that is two
parts.note: Gemini, a sign of the zodiac, means the Twins, so one of a pair is a twin

indicators.note: only a small part of the word is kept, the rest dropped from it

parts.note: it stands for the sign just mentioned, Gemini

explanation.surface: A riddling remark about a star sign and a small pain.
explanation.walkthrough: The 24 are the zodiac signs (24-across), twelve Latin names and twelve English. 'a bit of' keeps GE from GEMINI, dropping MINI.
explanation.definitionFit: A twinge is a brief sharp pain, something that hurts only slightly.

clue.text: Upholstery fabric, rubbishy stuff to clothe the naked

indicators.note: one word dresses the other by wrapping round it

parts.note: tat is cheap rubbish
naked means bare

explanation.surface: Covering the nude with cheap cloth for furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabaret is a striped silk fabric used to cover furniture.

clue.text: Timeless children's author upset by playwright

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is turned upside down, read from bottom
time is abbreviated T, and it is dropped

parts.note: E. Nesbit wrote The Railway Children

explanation.surface: A children's writer annoyed by a dramatist.
explanation.walkthrough: NESBIT less T gives NESBI, reversed by 'upset'.
explanation.definitionFit: Henrik Ibsen was the Norwegian dramatist of A Doll's House.

clue.text: Target for one of the 24 and gift of another who stood for president

parts.note: Sagittarius the archer aims at the gold, the bullseye of an archery target
Aquarius the water-carrier brings water

explanation.surface: Two star signs, the archer's aim and the water-bearer's present.
explanation.definitionFit: Barry Goldwater was the Republican candidate for US president in 1964.

clue.text: A match for the devil?

definitions.meaning: an old name for a friction match

explanation.definitionFit: Lucifer was the brand-name for early matches and is also a name of Satan.

clue.text: Desire to front old weapon

parts.note: to long for is to desire
the bow is the front of a ship

explanation.surface: A wish to lead with an ancient arm.
explanation.definitionFit: The longbow was the medieval English archer's weapon.

clue.text: Chanel No 1 is drinkable

parts.note: Coco Chanel, the French fashion designer
A is first, number one

explanation.surface: A perfume number that you could drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Chanel No 5 is the famous scent; here 'drinkable' is a noun, a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocoa is a hot chocolate beverage, a drinkable in the noun sense.

clue.text: Indulgent one of 24 raised a bit differently at home between successive notes

indicators.note: these pieces sit inside the pair of notes

parts.note: F and G are consecutive notes of the scale

indicators.note: the sign's letters are rearranged and lifted into a new order

parts.note: Virgo is a zodiac sign
in means at home

explanation.surface: A tolerant star sign, brought up a bit differently, staying in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised a bit differently' scrambles the sign's letters to ORGIV; with 'at home' after it, this sits 'between' the two notes F and G.
explanation.definitionFit: Forgiving means lenient, ready to pardon, which is indulgent.

clue.text: Stand up to the others, securing lives

indicators.note: the others hold the other word firmly inside

parts.note: the rest means the others
is means exists or lives

explanation.surface: Defying everyone else while keeping alive.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose or withstand, standing up to someone.

clue.text: One of the 24 found on another, a Thespian

definitions.text: One of the 24 found on another
definitions.meaning: Libra is the ..., and ... cover Pisces, the fish

explanation.definitionFit: Scales are the sign Libra and fish skin, and Prunella Scales is an actress.

clue.text: Major church's interdict embracing quartz etc

indicators.note: one word hugs the other, so the second goes inside the first

parts.note: an interdict is a prohibition, a ban
quartz and its relatives are forms of silica

explanation.surface: A papal ban on a cathedral is somehow tied up with minerals.
explanation.definitionFit: Basilican is the adjective for a basilica, a large and important church, so it means belonging to one.

clue.text: One of the 24 less 10, first to last in body

indicators.note: the opening letter is moved round to the end of the word
less means minus, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: Scorpio is a zodiac sign
the figures 1 and 0 look like the letters I and O

explanation.surface: Arithmetic on a star sign, rearranged in a body.
explanation.walkthrough: SCORPIO less IO gives SCORP; 'first to last' moves the S to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A corps is an organised body of people, such as an army unit.

clue.text: Give fresh start to French boy on top of world

indicators.note: one piece is placed before the other

parts.note: René is a French boy's name
W is an abbreviation for world

explanation.surface: A French lad standing on top of the globe gets a new start.
explanation.definitionFit: To renew something is to restart it or make it fresh again.

clue.text: Two of the 24 merge with volumes

indicators.note: the two names overlap, sharing the letter where they meet

parts.note: Libra is a zodiac sign
Aries is another zodiac sign

explanation.surface: Two star signs joining up with some books.
explanation.walkthrough: LIBRA and ARIES share the A where they join, so one A goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Libraries are collections of books, so by metonymy they stand for volumes.

clue.text: Roman historian's account suppressed by emperor

indicators.note: the account is held down inside the emperor's name

parts.note: Titus was a Roman emperor

explanation.surface: An imperial cover-up of a historian's version of events.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacitus wrote the Annals and Histories of imperial Rome.

clue.text: Mixed drinks for fellow with evening dress

parts.note: cock is old slang for a fellow
tails is formal evening dress

explanation.surface: Cocktails for a man in white tie.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocktails are mixed alcoholic drinks.

clue.text: Large beast's entry to attain heaven

indicators.note: the beast enters the other word, going inside it

parts.note: to attain is to win
an elk is a large deer

explanation.surface: A big animal makes its way into paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: Welkin is a poetic word for the sky or the heavens.

clue.text: 9 dressed with clogs many years ago

indicators.note: the letters are dressed up in new order

parts.note: nine written out

explanation.surface: Nine people kitted out in wooden shoes ages back.
explanation.definitionFit: Long since is an idiom for a long time ago.

clue.text: Traumatise sailor with 29

parts.note: to scar someone is to traumatise them
AB is an able-bodied seaman

explanation.surface: Upsetting a seaman with a creepy-crawly.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarab is a kind of beetle, sacred in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Two of the 24 merge with valuable mass

indicators.note: the two names overlap, sharing the letter where they meet

parts.note: the Bull is the English name of Taurus
the Lion is the English name of Leo

explanation.surface: Two star signs joining up with some treasure.
explanation.walkthrough: BULL and LION share an L where they join, so one L goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Bullion is gold or silver in bulk, a mass of precious metal.

clue.text: Capital fellow with a share of the Guardian

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: only a portion of the newspaper's name is kept, its opening three letters

parts.note: the name of the British newspaper, written out in full

explanation.surface: A man holding a stake in a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a share of' looks like one phrase, but 'a' gives its own letter and 'share of' takes only the start of the paper's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Managua is the capital city of Nicaragua.

clue.text: 24 from 12 and 18 translated their mental state

indicators.note: the names are put into another language and then shuffled

parts.note: Aries in 12-across translates as the Ram
the Lion in 18-down translates to Latin as Leo

explanation.surface: Signs taken from earlier answers say how a group feels.
explanation.definitionFit: Morale is the spirit or confidence of a group.

clue.text: Winner kept 2 topped with proverbial aphrodisiac

indicators.note: the winner holds the other piece inside

parts.note: an ace is a winning serve or card

indicators.note: in a down clue the top letter is cut off

parts.note: 2-down is the playwright

explanation.surface: A champion keeping a dramatist, crowned with a love potion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topped' cuts the first letter from 2-down, giving BSEN; 'kept' puts it inside the winner. The proverb is 'Absence makes the heart grow fonder'.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says absence makes the heart grow fonder, so it stirs love.

clue.text: Removal expert when in Queens

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other

parts.note: ER is the abbreviation for Elizabeth Regina, so two queens give it twice
as means when

explanation.surface: A removal man working in a New York borough.
explanation.definitionFit: An eraser removes marks, so it is an expert at removal.

clue.text: Copper in French bed, put back into back, is netted

indicators.note: the built-up piece goes inside the word for back

parts.note: the rear is the back

indicators.note: copper is set inside the turned bed
the bed is turned round, read from end to start

parts.note: lit is French for bed
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A policeman caught in a French bed, bundled out the back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' turns the bed to TIL before the copper goes 'in', making TICUL; 'into' puts that inside the rear. The first 'back' is the indicator, the second the piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticular means net-like or reticulated, formed like a mesh.

clue.text: Island from one of the 24 …

indicators.note: the island is taken from the sign, leaving the rest

parts.note: Capricorn is a zodiac sign

explanation.surface: An island named from a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples.

clue.text: … 12 in Latin and 12 in English (one 12 back to a 100)

definitions.text: … 12 in Latin and 12 in English (one 12 back to a 100)

parts.words: 12 in Latin and 12 in English (one 12 back to a 100)
parts.note: I DOZ reversed plus A C gives ZODIAC as a hint

explanation.walkthrough: The parenthesis is a secondary hint: 'one 12' is I DOZ, back gives ZODI, then 'a 100' is A C, making ZODIAC. Hence the 24 in the puzzle: Libra and Scales count twice.
explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac signs are twelve, named in Latin (Aries) or English (Ram), making 24 names.

clue.text: … which retains temperature when attacked

indicators.note: one piece keeps the other inside it

parts.note: refers back to Capricorn, the goat

explanation.surface: Something that holds heat when under fire.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins 23-down: 'which' is the sign there, Capricorn, the Goat.
explanation.definitionFit: Got at means attacked or got at someone, criticised.

clue.text: Remove top from page to economise

parts.note: to skim milk is to remove the cream from the top

explanation.surface: Advice to cut costs by taking the top off a page.
explanation.definitionFit: To skimp is to spend or use too little, to scrimp on something.

clue.text: I throw my weight around the angel

parts.note: to sling is to throw
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A boast of bossiness by a heavenly being.
explanation.walkthrough: The Angel is a London landmark and Tube station in Islington, the borough around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Islington is the north London district surrounding the Angel junction.

clue.text: One next to Pole and another first off

indicators.note: the opening letter is removed

parts.note: Prussia bordered Poland, so a Prussian is a Pole's neighbour

explanation.surface: Two neighbours of a Polish man, one losing his head.
explanation.definitionFit: Russia also borders Poland, so a Russian is another neighbour of a Pole.

clue.text: Party game with mallet

explanation.definitionFit: Beetle names both a dice drawing game and a heavy wooden hammer.
